🚛 Episode 3 — Fuel Logistics (Azure Data Factory)
"The best fuel in the world is useless if it never reaches the car." Your fuel tank (ADLS Gen2) is ready and waiting. But raw data doesn't teleport itself from SAP, Salesforce, IoT devices, or REST APIs into your lake. You need a logistics system — and that's Azure Data Factory (ADF). ADF is the fuel truck fleet of your data platform. It moves data. It doesn't transform it deeply (that's Spark's job), but it knows every road, every connection type, and every schedule.

I made an habit tracking journal app where users can write entries about their habit loops. A habit loop consists of a trigger or cue, a behavior, and a result.
